body: Founder: 'ok but i win every game i need the bots to be training on the full game rl' -> 'not just 2 heroes.' Full 20v20 team-mode training scoped down to the achievable slice: self-play across the whole hero roster. Real gap found and fixed: observation never included hero identity at all, so a policy couldn't condition behavior on which hero it's playing. ARENA_TRAINING_OBS_SIZE 18 -> 18+2*ARENA_HERO_COUNT (one-hot self+foe hero_id). New sim_step_both() drives both heroes via real external actions (self-play needs this, not the stable heuristic). rl_env.py gained randomize_heroes + opponent_model_path (frozen SB3 checkpoint), both off by default. rl_train.py exposes both as CLI flags plus a second eval pass. Live consumers updated to match, guarded by #if RL_POLICY_OBS_SIZE so it's safe to land before a matching model exists -- verified zero behavior change against the currently-live 18-input model. 2 new tests, full suite green.
title: feat: full-roster self-play RL infrastructure (hero one-hot observation + sim_step_both)
